records.jp: それでは星崎さん、<CR>私をプールに突き落として貰えますか？
records.en_original: Now then, would you mind pushing me into the pool, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Now then,<CR>would you mind pushing me into the pool, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: うん、もちろんだよ！
records.en_original: My pleasure!
records.en: My pleasure!

records.en_original: ...Wait, what?
records.en: ...Wait, what?

records.jp: どうしたんですか？<CR>早くお願いします。
records.en_original: What is it? Please hurry.
records.en: What is it?<CR>Please hurry.

records.jp: ど、どどどどうしたんですかはこっちのセリフだよ！？<CR>一体どうしたの詩さん！？
records.en_original: Wh-wh-what are you asking me for?! What's going on with you?!
records.en: That's what I should be asking!<CR>What on earth is wrong, Uta-san?!

records.jp: まあまあ、細かいことは気にせずに。<CR>さあ、突き落としてください。早く！
records.en_original: Don't worry so much about the little things. Now, push me!
records.en: Don't worry so much about the little things.<CR>Now, push me!

records.jp: ええい！　ままよ！
records.en_original: There! Good luck!
records.en: Here goes! Whatever happens, happens!

records.jp: あんっ
records.en_original: Oh my.
records.en: Ahhn!

records.jp: う、詩さん大丈夫！？
records.en_original: U-Uta, are you okay?!
records.en: U-Uta-san, are you okay?!

records.jp: 大丈夫です。ナイス突き落としでした
records.en_original: I'm fine. Excellent work.
records.en: I am fine. That was an excellent push.

records.jp: ナイス突き落とし……？
records.en_original: Excellent work...?
records.en: Excellent work...?

records.jp: む、無理だよ！<CR>詩さんを突き落とすなんて無理無理！
records.en_original: I-I can't do it! I can't just push you like this!
records.en: I-I can't!<CR>I can't push you off, Uta-san!

records.jp: そう言わずにお願いします……！<CR>私は、星崎さんに、突き落として欲しいんですっ！
records.en_original: Don't worry about all of that! I want you to push me!
records.en: Please, do not say that...!<CR>I want you to push me into the pool, Hoshizaki-san!

records.jp: えええええ！？　良くわからないけど<CR>そう言われたら余計に無理！！
records.en_original: Whaaat?! That doesn't make it easier! I don't get it!
records.en: Whaaat?! That doesn't make it easier!<CR>I don't get it!

records.jp: ……そう、ですか。残念です
records.en_original: Is that so... That's too bad.
records.en: Is that so... That's too bad.

records.jp: （な、なんか今日の詩さんおかしい……<CR>言動が変だし、いつもより積極的だし……）
records.en_original: (Uta's acting weird today... She would normally never say stuff like this...)
records.en: (Uta-san's acting weird today...<CR>She would normally never say stuff like this...)

records.jp: 星崎さん、あの大きな浮き輪に乗ってみませんか？
records.en_original: Hoshizaki, would you like to get on that floatie with me?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, would you like to get on that floatie with me?

records.jp: も、もちろんいいよ！
records.en_original: O-of course!
records.en: O-of course!

records.jp: 水って怖いですよね……
records.en_original: Water is scary, don't you think?
records.en: Water is scary, don't you think?

records.jp: え？　突然何……？
records.en_original: Huh? What's this all of a sudden...?
records.en: Huh? What's this all of a sudden...?

records.jp: 水は、あらゆる命の源とも言えます。<CR>でも時に、簡単に人の命を……奪う
records.en_original: They call water the giver of life, but it can just as easily take life away.
records.en: They call water the giver of life,<CR>but it can just as easily take life away.

records.jp: は、はい
records.en_original: R-right.
records.en: R-right.

records.jp: 例えば私はあまり泳ぐのが得意ではありませんが
records.en_original: You know, I'm not the strongest swimmer.
records.en: You know, I'm not the strongest swimmer.

records.jp: そうなんだ
records.en_original: Oh yeah?
records.en: Oh yeah?

records.jp: そんな私が、もし仮にこの浮き輪を<CR>ひっくり返されれば……どうなってしまうのでしょう
records.en_original: If, for example, this floatie were to be overturned, who knows what would happen to me.
records.en: If, for example,<CR>this floatie were to be overturned, who knows what would happen to me.

records.jp: え
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: どうなってしまうのでしょう……ふふふ
records.en_original: Who knows indeed... Hehehe.
records.en: Who knows indeed... Hehehe.

records.jp: （なんで笑ってるんだこの人！？<CR>まさか以前の性格が、いや、でも……）
records.en_original: (Why is she laughing?! Could her old personality be...? No, it couldn't be...)
records.en: (Why is she laughing?!<CR>Could her old personality be...? No, it couldn't be...)

records.jp: （も、もしかしてこれ、<CR>浮き輪をひっくり返せって言ってる！？）
records.en_original: (D-does she want me to tip the floatie over?!)
records.en: (D-does she want<CR>me to tip the floatie over?!)

records.jp: んーーーーよくわかんないけどえーいっ！
records.en_original: Mmm, I don't really get it, but fine!
records.en: I do not really understand, but... here goes!

records.jp: あんっ
records.en_original: Oh my.
records.en: Ahhn!

records.jp: ご、ごめん詩さん！　大丈夫……？
records.en_original: I-I'm sorry, Uta! Are you okay?
records.en: I-I'm sorry, Uta-san! Are you okay?

records.jp: ありがとうございます
records.en_original: Thank you very much.
records.en: Thank you very much.

records.jp: ありがとうございます！？
records.en_original: Thank you very much?!
records.en: Thank you very much?!

records.jp: お、おおお落ち着いて詩さん！<CR>近い！　近すぎるから！！
records.en_original: C-calm down, Uta! You're too close! Way too close!
records.en: C-calm down, Uta-san!<CR>You're too close! Way too close!

records.jp: ……ああ、すみません。<CR>気持ちが先走りました
records.en_original: Ah, excuse me. I seem to have gotten ahead of myself.
records.en: Ah, excuse me.<CR>I seem to have gotten ahead of myself.

records.jp: 詩さんなんか今日おかしいよ！？
records.en_original: You're acting super weird today!
records.en: Uta-san, you are acting strange today!?

records.jp: うっ、バレてしまいましたか……
records.en_original: I've been found out...
records.en: I've been found out...

records.jp: 実は――
records.en_original: The truth is—
records.en: The truth is—

records.jp: つまり、勇希ときららから仲良くなるには<CR>「いじり」と「いじられ」が大事だと教わって
records.en_original: So you learned from Yuki that friends tease each other?
records.en: In other words, Yuki and Kirara taught you that<CR>teasing and being teased are important for becoming closer?

records.jp: はい……いじられてみました……
records.en_original: Yes... I wanted you to tease me.
records.en: Yes... I tried being the one who was teased...

records.jp: 星崎さんともっと仲良くなれればと思ったのですが……<CR>やっぱりぎこちなかったでしょうか？
records.en_original: I thought that it might bring us closer together... Did it feel unnatural?
records.en: I thought it might help me get closer to Hoshizaki-san...<CR>Was it awkward after all?

records.jp: いや、怖いぐらいはまってたよ……
records.en_original: No, if anything it worked so well it was scary...
records.en: No, if anything it worked so well it was scary...

records.jp: 詩さんの「いじり」と「いじられ」は<CR>本来こういうのなんだよねぇ、たぶん……
records.en_original: You played the role as good as anyone I've ever seen...
records.en: I suppose this is probably what teasing and<CR>being teased normally look like for you, Uta-san...

records.jp: 流石にちょっと違和感が大きかったかな
records.en_original: I did think it was maybe a little strange...
records.en: I did think it was maybe a little strange...

records.jp: そうですか……。作戦失敗です
records.en_original: I see... I failed.
records.en: I see... I failed.

records.jp: いや！　いやいや、でもそうやって<CR>考えてくれたのは嬉しいから！　うん！
records.en_original: No, not at all! If anything, I'm glad that you feel that way!
records.en: No, no!<CR>I am happy that you thought so seriously about becoming closer to me! Really!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
